summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency source resolves to a mutable default branch at install time
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:Kelvdra/libsignal` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On `npm install`, npm clones the default branch of that GitHub repository and installs whatever it currently contains, running any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tree. The referenced repository is owned by the same account that publishes this npm package, and its contents can change at any time with no registry integrity check, no hash verification, and no tarball immutability. Any code pushed to that branch after publication will execute on installer machines the next time this package is installed. A separate static match on `ping` inside lib/Utils/generics.js appears in ordinary WebSocket keepalive/protocol handling in this Baileys fork and is not by itself indicative of exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
